{"claims":[{"claim_text":"President Obama and the Democratic Party believe America has the best workers and businesses in the world.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"If the playing field is level, Americans will be able to compete against every other country on Earth.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Over the last four years, progress was made toward doubling U.S. exports by 2015.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Steps were taken to open new markets to American products while ensuring other countries play by the same rules.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Obama signed into law new trade agreements with South Korea, Colombia, and Panama that will support tens of thousands of private-sector jobs.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The trade agreements with South Korea, Colombia, and Panama were strengthened on behalf of American workers and businesses before being signed into law by President Obama.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to finding more markets for American-made goods, including using the Trans-Pacific Partnership between the United States and eight countries in the Asia-Pacific.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to ensuring workers' rights and environmental standards are upheld in trade agreements.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to fighting against unfair trade practices.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Assistance for trade-affected workers was expanded and reformed.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Demand for renewal of assistance for trade-affected workers alongside new trade agreements.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
